LibreDWG 0.13.3 (win64) - used by MonoLith to open DWG files when the ODA File Converter is not installed.

LibreDWG is free software from the GNU project, licensed under the GNU General Public License
version 3 or later (see COPYING.txt). MonoLith runs these programs as separate tools
(dwg2dxf.exe: DWG -> DXF, dxf2dwg.exe: DXF -> DWG R2000); it does not link to them.

Unmodified binaries from: https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/releases/tag/0.13.3
